verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm. A service business with an online presence could conceivably publish an official MCP server for agents, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes any MCP server, API, or agent integration, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
